text: Artificial intelligence is changing our world quickly, but it also brings serious ethical questions. One major concern is bias. If AI systems learn from data that contains unfair patterns, they can make decisions that discriminate against certain groups. Fairness means we must check these systems carefully to ensure they treat everyone equally. Privacy is another issue, since AI often collects huge amounts of personal information, and people need to know how their data is used. Transparency is also essential; users should understand why an AI made a particular choice, especially in areas like hiring or healthcare. Above all, responsible AI development requires designers, companies, and governments to work together, setting clear rules and constantly testing for harm. Ultimately, technology should serve humanity, not the other way around, and ethics must guide every step of its creation.
